Chasen v0.1.5 requires Zig 0.17.1.

## Filesystem watching

Use `ctx.watch().start` to watch a directory or a selected entry and `ctx.watch().cancel` to stop watching. Chasen uses inotify on Linux and FSEvents on macOS. [Filesystem watching](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen/blob/v0.1.5/docs/RUNTIME.md#filesystem-watching)

## Runtime and terminal fixes

- Task workers keep results in stable, correctly aligned storage until delivery or cleanup. This fixes failures with highly aligned task messages on Zig 0.17.1.
- On Linux, foreground jobs and the terminal backend use the kernel terminal settings layout when saving and restoring terminal state.
- If a terminal times out during startup capability detection, Shift+F3 input and later cursor-position queries still work. This release includes [libvaxis at 25b4bd7](https://github.com/rockorager/libvaxis/commit/25b4bd7371cc3c32049e103ab292a525a1ecb7a7).

## Custom image loaders

`TerminalImageLoaderVaxis.transmitImage` now takes `(allocator, tty, bytes, width, height, format)`. Pass PNG file bytes for `.png` or packed pixels for `.rgb` and `.rgba`. For bytes already encoded as Base64, use `transmitPreEncodedImage`. [Terminal images and options](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen/blob/v0.1.5/docs/RUNTIME.md#terminal-images-and-options)
